findings.what: After the Clips sample page (?clips=preview) is opened once in a browser, every later visit to the real Clips tab while signed out shows the owner review box "Waiting for you", a red dot on Clips and a "Take down" button under every clip.
findings.where: public/js/v2/clips.js:270 (preview pullQueue calls keepVerdict(true) and stores {w:"",owner:true} in localStorage dsClipsOwner); ownerVerdict() at clips.js:46 then matches any signed-out visitor

findings.what: The Game choice on Send a link and Share a clip only offers slither.io, Paper.io, agar.io, Battle royale and Other, so clips of Pac-Man, Knockout, Head Soccer, Swim, 8 Ball Pool, Air Hockey, Rooftop Snipers and Crossy Road can only be filed as Other, while agar.io (Coming soon) is still offered.
Clips writes the game names in lower case ("slither.io", "agar.io") on cards and in the Game choice, while the lobby, sidebar and game cards say "Slither.io" and "Agar.io".
The live Clips wall is all test content: 7 clips by the owner's own names MrPeanutK and MrPeanut2, almost all tagged "Other" with no caption, and Top clippers lists only MrPeanutK.

Pressing Send a link while signed out opens the Privy window in a cold navy colour scheme that matches nothing else on the site, and the words disagree: the header button says "Sign in", the toast says "Log in to share a clip" and the window says "Log in or sign up".
findings.where: public/js/v2/clips.js:387-391 (needLogin toast); Privy appearance in the wallet widget (wallet-widget/src); header button public/v2.html:6125

findings.what: The Share a clip dialog shows a small clip's size as "0.0 MB".

Several PC-only controls are tiny: clip Download / Copy link / Post on X are 24 px tall, "Watch on X" is a 14 px tall text link, and on Join us "See updates" is 23 px tall and the email address link 21 px.
findings.where: public/v2.html:1559-1560 (.clsh button), clips.js card(); public/css/join.css:93 and 101 (.jn-upd button, .jn-mail)

findings.what: The three PC-only tabs each use a different page width and alignment: Clips is a wide left-aligned grid starting at x=290, Updates is a 680 px column starting at x=508, and Join us is a 520 px centred column with a 36 px heading instead of the 31 px heading on the other two.
Updates is one 37,000 px long page with all 104 posts and about 54 pictures, with no paging, no filter by tag and no way back to the top except scrolling.
findings.where: public/js/v2/updates.js draw() (every post in updates.json is drawn at once)

findings.what: The X, TikTok and YouTube circles on Join us are greyed placeholders that do nothing, with a line under them saying they are opening soon.
The fan of game cards at the top of Join us features agar.io and Battleship, two games that are currently Coming soon and cannot be played.
The Whop row promises money: "Post DuelSeries clips and get paid for the views."
On the phone there is no Join us at all, so the Discord invite, the Whop clip team and the socials can only be reached through Settings > Contact > Ask on Discord.
The cancel choice on the gold confirm card ("Stay") is a 57x31 px text button, below the 44 px tap size on a phone.

Popups come in four looks: the DSDialog card has a gold rim and 22 px corners, the lobby's own dialogs (Send a link) have no rim and 18 px corners, the Support panel has a grey border and 14 px corners, and the Privy sign-in is navy.
findings.where: public/js/shared/dsDialog.js:24-30; public/v2.html .howcard; public/js/v2/support.js:24-30; Privy theme in the wallet widget

findings.what: Terms, Privacy and Responsible play are still published as drafts: each opens with a gold "Draft. ... not been reviewed by a lawyer" box, and five gold-highlighted [bracket] placeholders are left in the text (3 in Terms, 1 in Privacy, 1 in Responsible play).
Terms calls it "The nightly Battle Royale" although the lobby shows it running every few hours, and its Money section uses the word "Deposits" where the wallet says Add funds.
On the phone the legal footer links are 24 px tall and the in-text links (the email address, ConnexOntario) are 17 px tall, and the footer has no Contact link although the lobby footer does.
findings.where: public/css/legal.css .links a; legal pages footer nav

findings.what: The old /game.html is still served: opening it directly drops you into the old snake engine as "Player" with its own HUD and CASH OUT button, and its tab title "DuelSeries - Playing" uses a hyphen where every other page uses "·"; only play.js fallbacks still point at it.
findings.where: public/game.html; public/js/v2/play.js:509,582,830 (fallbacks); not blocked in server/index.js DEV_ONLY_PAGES

findings.what: The lobby is still served at two extra addresses, /v2 and /v2.html, which nothing on the site links to.

The /clip/<id> page shows "DuelSeries" where the game name should be for a clip tagged Other, and its header wordmark is all white instead of the two-tone "Duel" + grey "Series" used on the lobby and legal pages.
Every duel's Free cell says "bot joins after 15 s" but the real wait is 10 seconds.
findings.where: public/owner.html:1156 and 1239; real value shared/duelWait.js WAIT_MS = 10000

findings.what: On the PC sheet the "Coming soon" half of the agar.io and Battleship switches wraps onto two lines and the word "soon" is cut off.
findings.where: public/owner.html:37-38 (.tg fixed 34 px height, .tg button) via partSoon() at owner.html:859

findings.what: In "Done today" the time runs straight into the text, so it reads "11:57amslither.io free: bots set to 8".
findings.where: public/owner.html:1100 (partLog: span.t followed by the note with no gap)

findings.what: On the phone layout the "In the lobby" rows for agar.io and Battleship sit flush against the left edge of the screen while every other row has an 18 px margin.

findings.what: Owner controls on the phone are 32 to 34 px tall (bot - and + steppers 32x32, Open/Closed switches, Sign in 72x34, Join buttons) and the Devices "Close" link is 35x20, all under the 44 px tap size.
findings.where: public/owner.html:31-43 (.step, .tg, .btn), devices dialog #devClose; public/js/ownerLive.js row buttons

findings.what: The Control tab names games "slither.io", "agar.io" and "Chomp" while the console's own Live tab and the lobby call them "Slither.io", "Agar.io" and "Pac-Man".
findings.where: server/index.js:1899, 1903, 1905 (consoleGames names); Live names come from server/livePlayers.js:49

findings.what: The escrow alert gives bare numbers with no unit ("Escrow 0.27 is below the live stakes 0.29 (short 0.01)") while the rest of the console is in dollars, and a negative spare shows as "$-1.82".

Owner confirmations (close paid rooms, maintenance, sign out other devices) use the browser's plain grey confirm box instead of the site's gold DSDialog card, and the Live tab's join toasts are their own style rather than DSToast.

styleNotes: Type is consistent: Archivo everywhere in scope (lobby tabs, toasts, DSDialog, legal, 404, /clip page, owner), IBM Plex Mono for Updates dates, toast amounts and clip lengths.
Headings drift: Clips and Updates h2 31px/700, Join us h2 36px/700, legal h1 40px (32px phone), owner h1 20px/650, DSDialog title 18px/700.

Buttons drift: lobby primary is bone #f4f1ea with 10px corners (Upload a clip 141x38, 404 Back to games 147x52); DSDialog primary is a gold gradient pill 44px tall; owner buttons are bone or outlined, 9px corners, 34px tall; /clip page buttons 36px with 10px corners and a green text "Play DuelSeries" link.
Corner radii in popups: DSDialog 22px, lobby .howcard 18px, toasts / Support panel / owner dialog 14px.

Colour tokens match across lobby, legal and 404 (bg #100e0b, s1 #17140f, tx #f5f1e8, tx2 #a89c8a, money #f0a830); owner.html has its own near-copies (s1 #16130f, tx2 #b3a793, ok #8ed081, bad #e0705f).
Toast kinds are told apart by tinted border plus icon (green check, red cross, gold $, bone i or spinner), 320px wide bottom right on PC, 360px above the bottom bar on phone, 3 at most.
With reduced motion toasts only fade (opacity 1e-05s); with motion on they slide in over 0.3s. The DSDialog spinner turns under reduced motion on purpose.
Full-page capture of the lobby renders Home instead of the active tab, so long lobby tabs were captured as several viewport shots.
keep: PC-only gating works: on the phone the Clips, Updates and Join us nav buttons and screens are display:none and go() to any of them lands on Home, with no updates.json or /api/clips fetch.
DSToast: tinted cards with icon and colour per outcome, money amounts in gold mono, sticky spinner, max 3 stacked, sits above the phone bottom bar, simple fade under reduced motion.
DSDialog gold card: clear title and line, 44px gold pill, Escape closes, spinner keeps turning under reduced motion.
Updates timeline: mono dates on a rail, coloured Fix/New/Event/Heads up tags, big hero pictures with alt text, unread dot that clears when the tab is opened, fresh posts marked.
Updates picture viewer: large picture with caption, arrows and arrow keys for galleries, Escape closes and focus returns to the picture.
Updates and Clips empty and error states are plain sentences ("Nothing posted yet.", "Updates did not load. Check your connection and open the tab again.", "No clips yet" with how-to).
Clips: player sheet with the real video and Download / Copy link / Post on X; Upload checks the file at once (MP4 only toast); Send a link explains a bad link inline.
Join us: Discord and Whop as two equal rows, Invite a friend turns into "Link copied" in place, Report a bug and Send an idea open the Support panel prefilled.
Support panel: one panel for every write-to-us link (Copy, Open in Gmail, Ask on Discord), works on the legal pages too, no mailto.
Legal pages: one readable column in the site tokens, /terms /privacy /responsible-play now redirect to the .html pages, current page marked in the footer, no horizontal scroll on phone.
404 page: same sheet as the legal pages with one clear Back to games button; /api paths get a JSON 404.

Old and dev pages are closed: /admin, /admin.html, /game, /lobby-v2, /dev-*.html and /preview_snake.html answer 404; /shooter and /tanks.html go home; /play/<bad> and /clip/<bad> go home; nothing in the lobby links to an old page.

Owner console: the PC sheet (games down, Free / $0.50 / $1 across, paid door per game), the separate phone layout, the plain verdict ("Safe to restart" vs "2 people still in paid rooms"), escrow breakdown, Live and Today tabs, Devices dialog, and an alerts box that says when it is not connected.
/clip/<id> share page plays the clip and fits a phone.
notReached: Owner console with real data: every signed-in owner screen was MOCKED (/api/owner/session, /state, /sessions, /ticket and a stand-in socket.io); no owner action was sent.

Owner confirm boxes and any /api/owner/do action (maintenance, paid doors, bots, Set limit, announcement): not pressed, they are native confirm dialogs that block a headless page and would act on the live server.
Owner sign-in itself (Sign in button loads Privy and asks for a wallet signature): not pressed.
Clips owner actions (Approve, Reject, Take down), Send link / Share clip submit, Delete in Your clips: not pressed, they need the owner or player wallet signature and would change live data.
Your clips list with the player's own clips: the signed-in stub cannot sign clips:mine, so only the drop box shows.
Clip Download and Post on X: not pressed (a file download and an external site).
Discord, Whop and Gmail links: not opened (external sites).
Updates, Clips and Join us on the phone: hidden by design, only the redirect to Home was checked.

The probe's Fetch mock cannot reach requests the lobby's service worker relays, so lobby empty and error states were produced with an in-page fetch stand-in (and, for the Updates error, a fresh browser so the first load failed).
Shot updates-pc-gallery (gallery strip scrolled into view) came out garbled mid-scroll and is not used.
